# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_SPIKE_AT_VWAP_RIBBON_ALIGN_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A surge in volume coinciding with a VWAP break and a bullish EMA ribbon alignment signals strong institutional buying. This edge exists because institutional accumulation often manifests as above-average volume when price breaks above VWAP with a bullish ribbon structure, indicating sustained buying pressure and trend initiation.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If volume exceeds 2× the average 5‑minute volume of the prior 20 bars and price closes above VWAP (close > VWAP) while the ribbon is bullish (EMA8 > EMA20 > EMA50) and the closing candle is bullish (close > open), then enter long at the close. Exit shape: chart-stop at the swing low prior to entry (lowest low of the last 5 bars), TP1 at 2R, runner trail 10% off HWM. Regime hint: Works when VIX is low‑moderate (<18) and the ribbon width (EMA8 - EMA50) >0.003 to ensure trend strength; avoid choppy markets where ribbon flattens.
